name: Expert_ADC_PL_RSI
summary: This EA uses the MQL5 Standard Library Expert Advisor framework with a custom CDC_PL_RSI signal filter combining RSI and Moving Average indicators to generate trade signals. It employs fixed lot money management with no trailing stop, relying on threshold-based signal logic for entry and exit decisions.
summary_zh: 该EA使用MQL5标准库专家框架，搭配自定义的CDC_PL_RSI信号过滤器，结合RSI和移动平均线指标生成交易信号。采用固定手数资金管理，无追踪止损，依赖阈值信号逻辑进行入场和出场决策。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于CDC_PL_RSI信号过滤器，结合RSI（周期20）和MA（周期14）两个动量指标来识别市场方向。入场条件由信号阈值控制，开仓阈值为40（0-100范围），当信号强度超过该阈值时开仓；平仓阈值为20，当信号强度低于该阈值时平仓。出场条件没有设置止损和止盈水平（StopLevel和TakeLevel均为0），仅依赖信号反转来平仓，这是一个明显的风险缺陷。仓位管理采用固定手数模式（CMoneyFixedLot），固定交易量为0.1手，资金百分比为10%。资金管理方面没有动态调整机制，不会根据账户余额或波动率调整仓位大小。整体策略缺乏止损保护，完全依赖信号过滤器判断出场时机，在极端行情下可能面临较大亏损风险。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the CDC_PL_RSI signal filter, combining RSI (period 20) and MA (period 14) momentum indicators to identify market direction. Entry conditions are controlled by signal thresholds: the opening threshold is 40 (on a 0-100 scale), triggering a trade when signal strength exceeds this level; the closing threshold is 20, closing positions when signal strength falls below. Exit conditions have no stop loss or take profit levels configured (both StopLevel and TakeLevel are 0.0), relying entirely on signal reversal for exits, which is a significant risk flaw. Position sizing uses a fixed lot model (CMoneyFixedLot) with a fixed volume of 0.1 lots and a percentage setting of 10%. Money management lacks dynamic adjustment mechanisms and does not scale position size based on account balance or market volatility. The overall strategy lacks stop loss protection and depends entirely on the signal filter for exit timing, potentially facing large losses during extreme market conditions.

parameters.name: Expert_MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于标识订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for order identification

parameters.name: Expert_EveryTick
parameters.description: 是否每个Tick都执行交易逻辑
parameters.description_en: Execute trading logic on every tick

pros: 使用MQL5标准库Expert框架，代码结构清晰规范，模块化程度高
信号系统采用阈值控制，开仓和平仓阈值分离，提供灵活的信号过滤机制
Expert_EveryTick设为false，仅在K线完成时计算，避免噪音干扰并降低计算开销
pros_en: Uses the MQL5 Standard Library Expert framework with clean, modular code structure
Signal system uses separate thresholds for opening and closing, providing flexible signal filtering
Expert_EveryTick set to false, calculating only on bar completion to avoid noise and reduce computational overhead
cons: 止损和止盈水平均为0，缺乏基本的风险保护机制，极端行情下可能遭受重大损失
固定手数资金管理不考虑账户余额和波动率变化，无法动态调整风险敞口
无追踪止损机制（使用TrailingNone），盈利头寸无法锁定浮盈，可能回吐利润
仅依赖单一信号过滤器，缺乏多信号确认或过滤冗余，策略稳健性不足
cons_en: Stop loss and take profit levels are both zero, lacking basic risk protection which may cause significant losses in extreme markets
Fixed lot money management ignores account balance and volatility changes, unable to dynamically adjust risk exposure
No trailing stop mechanism (uses TrailingNone), profitable positions cannot lock in gains and may give back profits
Relies on a single signal filter without multi-signal confirmation or redundancy, reducing strategy robustness
improvements: 添加止损和止盈参数并设置合理默认值，确保每笔交易都有基本的风险保护
将固定手数替换为基于ATR或账户余额的动态仓位管理，实现自适应风险控制
添加追踪止损机制替代TrailingNone，在趋势行情中锁定浮盈
improvements_en: Add stop loss and take profit parameters with reasonable defaults to ensure basic risk protection on every trade
Replace fixed lot sizing with ATR-based or account-equity-based dynamic position management for adaptive risk control
Add a trailing stop mechanism to replace TrailingNone, locking in floating profits during trending markets

risk_points: 止损和止盈均为0，交易无硬性止损保护，极端行情下可能无限亏损
无追踪止损机制，盈利头寸无法保护浮盈
固定手数不考虑账户规模变化，小账户可能过度杠杆
risk_points_en: Stop loss and take profit both zero means no hard stop protection, potentially unlimited losses in extreme markets
No trailing stop mechanism means profitable positions have no floating profit protection
Fixed lot sizing ignores account size changes, small accounts may be over-leveraged
